title: Total influence when the head coalition dominates
statement: Let $k,m:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. If $m(q)\to\infty$ and $k(q)/\sqrt{k(q)+m(q)}\to\infty$, then the probability that the first $k(q)$ coordinates can make majority attain both possible outputs, for a uniformly random input on $k(q)+m(q)$ coordinates, converges to $1$.
